column4: MySQL-only by subject: all three controls build MySQL scratch databases to prove the snapshot now SELECTs COLUMNS.EXTRA, STATISTICS.COLLATION and TABLE_CONSTRAINTS.ENFORCED, so there is no PostgreSQL or SQL Server arm to run. THREE rather than one because the gate is mysqlScratchDB called INSIDE each t.Run via mysqlDiffCase, not a single gate at the top of the parent -- so the parent reports PASS while all three subtests skip. Measured by NAME, not by delta, with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL unset: go test ./migration/catalogdiff/ -run TestTheMySQLSnapshotSeesTheAttributesItSelects -count=1 -json reports exactly these three names and no failures; the bare parent name is reported PASS, not skipped, so a line granting the parent would match nothing. This job supplies PostgreSQL only; Tier 1 Gate and multi-db-ci.yml set CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and run the three for real. cleat#2446, cleat#2448.
